name: Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt -ORIGIN-
source:
-ORIGIN- is a prequel bonus story to Survivor's Guilt, taking place 3 years before the main game, during the 50th season of the Danganronpa TV show.

[From [url=https://darkraven616.itch.io/danganronpa-survivors-guilt-origin]itch.io[/url]]
